messages:
Dave M: quick check — i'm about to merge a terraform + helm change to rotate the payments svc secrets and switch ExternalSecrets to use vault/kv-v2 path. would appreciate a quick look for anything that would break prod token refresh. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/462

Bob H: link pls, will scan. which clusters? staging + prod?

Dave M: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/462 — affects payments-staging & payments-prod k8s overlays. terraform change:

```hcl
resource "vault_kv_secret" "payments_tokens" {
  path = "secret/data/payments/service-tokens"
  data_json = jsonencode({
    token = random_password.payments.result
  })
}

module "external_secrets" {
  source = "./modules/external-secrets"
  path   = "kv/data/payments"
}
```

Alice R: quick read — the tf looks fine but helm values change for extsecret refresh missing. extsecrets default refreshInterval is 1m, current overlay has 5m. if tokens rotate, we might not pick up fast enough. add annotation or change controllerconfig?

Dave M: good catch. i intentionally bumped to 5m to reduce traffic, but for rotation window we can temporarily set to 30s in prod during rollout. patch i can add. sample patch:

```bash
# annotate to force faster refresh during rollout
kubectl -n payments annotate externalsecret payments-secret external-secrets.io/refresh=30s --overwrite
```

Carol S: can we do a canary deploy first? prod-slice-1 only. if fails, rollback. also confirm no downtime for clients.

Bob H: helm values file diff — overlay change:

```diff
- externalsecrets:
-   refreshInterval: 5m
+ externalsecrets:
+   refreshInterval: 30s
+   canary: true
```

Dave M: added canary strategy in the helm values and updated extsecret annotation. updated PR with commit sha: b3f9c2a. also ran vault-bot to schedule rotation.

vault-bot: rotation scheduled for payments-prod at 2398765510 (initiated by @Dave M)

Alice R: lgtm from me after small nit. please add a short runbook step for oncall: how to force refresh with kubectl delete secret or annotate extsecret with 'external-secrets.io/refresh: 1'

Bob H: nit: make sure service account on payments has 'secrets/rotate' policy scoping. otherwise rotation token won't be readable.

Dave M: added runbook entry and policy change. will merge in 30m, tagging @Carol S @Alice R for post-merge check. :thumbsup:

vault-bot: rotation executed for payments-prod at 2398765510 — new versions issued.

Carol S: watching logs; getting a handful of 500s from payment-worker for ~2m, looks like old pods still trying to use old token, but restart recovered. mark incident? no, transient. keep monitoring.

Dave M: merged. thanks all. follow-up: we'll revert refreshInterval to 5m after 1h of stability.
